question: Do frozen R17 industry target allocations conceal stock target changes from monthly membership?
source: R17 holdings unchanged, R05 L1 assignments at origin month as used by R17 risk diagnostics
weights: industry target weight/(resolved unique members+unresolved); unresolved mass retained; no renormalization
distance: sum abs(new nominal stock target minus old nominal stock target), no price drift; initial entry and final liquidation separate
unknown_bounds: known-coordinate L1 d with unresolved mass u_old,u_new: max(0,d-u_old-u_new) to min(2,d+u_old+u_new); conservative identity-overlap uncertainty
comparison: same adjacent origins industry target-to-target L1; R17 turnover is drift-adjusted industry measure and is not subtracted as equivalent
controls: detect calendar gaps, no continuity assumption across missing origins; equal/momentum/F/FD separate; no optimization
limits: nominal diagnostic only, not realized turnover or incremental fees; changing price-covered constituents and monthly synthetic reset remain unreplicated
